'''''Carex leporina''''' is a species of [[Carex|sedge]] known in the [[British Isles]] as '''oval sedge'''<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> and in North America as '''eggbract sedge'''. It is native to Eurasia and eastern and western North America, where it grows in seasonally wet habitat, such as meadows and fields. This sedge produces many thin stems and narrow leaves. The [[inflorescence]] is an open cluster of several flower spikes. The [[gynoecium|pistillate]] flower has a reddish or brownish [[bract]] with a gold center and white tip.
